answer: The garden counter is kept in ripple and pulse publishes each reset. An attacker as a result has to keep each alias continuously active for 37 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 37 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3064 identities would post 1217 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
